_comment: Field names match the ElevenLabs dashboard's webhook tool builder (Agent > Tools > Add tool > Webhook).
name: search_knowledge_base
description: Look up machining knowledge — alarm codes and first-response steps, cutting speeds/feeds by material, and safety procedures — from the shop's live knowledge base. Call this whenever the technician describes a problem, an alarm code, or asks a machining question.

query.description: The technician's question, restated clearly for search — e.g. 'alarm 402' or 'cutting speed for 6061 aluminum'.

response_notes: Backend returns { found, answer, needs_clarification, candidates: [{label, detail, distinguishing_condition}] }. See agent/system_prompt.md for how the agent should use needs_clarification/candidates to ask one follow-up question without calling this tool a second time.
